articles.title: Voter Guide Meet the Judicial Candidates on the Nov Ballot
articles.excerpt: Jimmy Blacklock has served on the Texas Supreme Court since 2018 and was previously general counsel to Gov. Greg Abbott (San Antonio Report).

articles.title: Texas Supreme Court Criminal Appeals Results Elections
articles.excerpt: Nov. 3, 2026 result: Jimmy Blacklock lost the race for Texas Supreme Court, Chief Justice with 4,625,886 votes (47.6%); opponent: Maggie Ellis (D) 5,102,288 (52.4%), in unofficial returns (Texas Secretary of State; The Texas Tribune).
